bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
name=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name" 2>/dev/null)" = true || exit 61
logs="$(docker logs --tail 100 "$name" 2>&1 || true)"
if printf '%s\n' "$logs" | grep -q '^CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS$';then exit 0;fi
if printf '%s\n' "$logs" | grep -Ei 'EACCES|EPERM' >/dev/null;then exit 80;fi
if printf '%s\n' "$logs" | grep -Eqi 'password authentication failed|28P01';then exit 81;fi
if printf '%s\n' "$logs" | grep -Eqi 'database .* does not exist|3D000';then exit 82;fi
if printf '%s\n' "$logs" | grep -Eqi 'permission denied for (relation|table|schema|database)|42501';then exit 83;fi
if printf '%s\n' "$logs" | grep -Eqi 'ECONNREFUSED|ENETUNREACH|ETIMEDOUT|UND_ERR_CONNECT_TIMEOUT|fetch failed|EAI_AGAIN|ENOTFOUND|EHOSTUNREACH';then exit 84;fi
if printf '%s\n' "$logs" | grep -Fq 'CREATOR_POLL_EXISTING_WEBHOOK_MUST_NOT_BE_REPLACED';then exit 85;fi
if printf '%s\n' "$logs" | grep -Eqi 'relation .* does not exist|42P01';then exit 86;fi
if printf '%s\n' "$logs" | grep -Eqi 'ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND|Cannot find module|Cannot find package';then exit 87;fi
if printf '%s\n' "$logs" | grep -Eqi 'role .* does not exist|28000';then exit 88;fi
if printf '%s\n' "$logs" | grep -Fq 'CREATOR_POLL_RUNTIME_FAILED';then exit 89;fi
exit 90
